title: Halving-loop instruction
statement: Given registers $c$ and $r$, an exit state, a function assigning a state to each of three phases, and a phase $j$, the instruction is: test whether $c$ is zero, branching to the exit state if so and otherwise to phase $1$ when $j=0$; decrement $c$ and go to phase $2$ when $j=1$; or halve $r$ and go to phase $0$ when $j=2$.
hypotheses_covered: registers $c$ and $r$ in the seven-register set
a function from the three phases to states
a phase in the three-element set
